messages:
maya: FYI — need to lock the connector certification runbook and a tentative schedule for Snowflake + Databricks + top vector DBs so we can hit marketplace listing in Q2. Who can own the doc? :calendar:

lucas: I can take the compatibility matrix. Will add supported versions and compute footprint.

sasha: Partner ops — will coordinate with Snowflake PMs and Databricks PMs. Need partner logos + co-marketing approval window.

jamal: Legal note — make sure contract appendix covers marketplace co-listing. ETA review by 3/31.

emily: Field test suggestion — pilot with two customers (one mid-market + one enterprise). I'll draft the pilot plan.

darren: From runtime side — we need perf SLO tests (p50/p99), and KV cache behavior with vector DB backfill. I’ll add a perf harness.

maya: Great. Action items: lucas (compat matrix) due 3/15, darren (perf harness) due 3/20, emily (pilot plan) due 3/22, sasha (partner approvals) due 3/25, jamal (legal) 3/31. I'll own the runbook doc and rollout timeline.

ops-bot: Deploy reminder scheduled for 1774000000 — marketplace sync job will run. :robot_face:

tessa: Small ask — add an acceptance test for connector auth (OAuth vs username/pw) and vector DB ingestion schema. I can add test cases.

lucas: Adding a compatibility table with matrix rows: Snowflake versions, Databricks runtimes, vector DBs (Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate). Also add quantized model recommendations per connector.

maya: Let's meet Wed 10am PT to sign off on the runbook draft. Invite sent. :white_check_mark:

emily: I'll prep customer contact list for pilots and draft outreach template.

sasha: Noted — I'll ping partners this afternoon and request co-marketing assets + security questionnaires.

maya: Thanks all. I’ll create a GH issue with the runbook link and assignees after the meeting.

Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/partnerships/connector-runbook (internal)

Checklist snippet:
```
- compatibility matrix
- perf harness & benchmarks
- security questionnaire cleared
- legal appendix
- pilot plan + customer approvals
- co-marketing assets
- marketplace listing metadata
```
